limitations: This audits supplied CSV contents and current source hashes. Actual source transfer, compilation and observed terminal run are separate evidence; hashes are not signed runtime attestation.
Zero elapsed milliseconds is a reported sample at counter resolution, not zero network latency or a feed freshness guarantee.

357 catalog entries are reported by the manifest; only keyword-matched property rows were persisted. No ten-year match does not establish universal feed absence or exhaust differently named/inaccessible products.
DXY metadata does not establish an entitled ICE spot feed, quote availability, units, update cadence, observation timestamps or usable historical availability.
USDXOF is a reviewed false positive and must never substitute for DXY.
Two low-impact calendar value records and zero API errors do not establish complete high-impact coverage, revision handling, verified UTC, or historical known_at.
No macro prices, economic release values, credentials, account IDs, account balances or private filesystem paths are published.
